one_liner: FICTIONAL COMPANY used to show the output format. Nova Rail sells train tickets online across Europe from Paris; AI agents are key to cutting back-office costs and defending margins against carrier-direct apps.

snapshot.label: Business
snapshot.value: Online rail ticketing marketplace, B2C and business travel

snapshot.label: Size
snapshot.value: Around 600 employees, 40% in engineering and data

snapshot.label: Funding
snapshot.value: Series D, profitable since last year

ai_maturity.summary: Rules-based automation in support and an ML team focused on search; no generative AI in production yet.

evidence.fact: A rules-based chatbot handles refunds; the engineering blog says it resolves under a third of requests.
Hiring two ML engineers for search ranking and personalization.

strategic_priorities.evidence: CEO interview names margin per booking as the 2027 focus.
New B2B offer launched with three corporate clients.
Conference talk on the monolith migration.

use_cases.name: Refund and rebooking agents in the back office
use_cases.business_value: Agents process refund files in the existing tools during disruption peaks, without temporary staff.

use_cases.name: Expense reports and supplier invoices
use_cases.business_value: A daily routine matches invoices and expense reports, so the team closes the month faster.

use_cases.name: CRM updates and account briefs for B2B sales
use_cases.business_value: Agents update the CRM after each call and prepare briefs on new corporate prospects.

use_cases.name: Natural-language trip search
use_cases.business_value: Higher conversion on complex multi-leg trips.

use_cases.name: Weekly carrier and competitor watch
use_cases.business_value: A scheduled routine tracks carrier announcements on the web and X and sends a weekly summary.

stakeholders.cares_about: Cost per booking and margin by market
stakeholders.angle: Tie every use case to cost per contact or margin per booking.
Start where the pain is weekly and visible.

stakeholders.cares_about: Integration with the booking platform during the migration
stakeholders.angle: Show that agents work in existing tools, with SSO and audit logs.
Bring security in at the start, not at signature.

expansion_plan.motion: Refund agents on one market and one language.
expansion_plan.trigger: Agents clear more refund files than the current process.

expansion_plan.motion: All 9 markets, then finance routines for invoices and expense reports.
expansion_plan.trigger: Next disruption peak handled without extra staff.

expansion_plan.motion: Agents for B2B sales and partnerships; Grok API for trip search in the product.
expansion_plan.trigger: CFO validates the cost-per-file gains in the annual plan.

governance: Named executive sponsor and one owner per use case
Data access rules agreed with security before the pilot
Enablement plan for support agents and engineers

metrics.metric: Share of refund files closed by agents
Cost per file during disruption weeks
metrics.why: The number the CFO already tracks.
Shows the impact of the finance routines.

risks.mitigation: Walk security through EU data residency options early.

risks.risk: IT worries about agents acting in business tools
risks.mitigation: Start with read-only access and action recording, then widen permissions role by role.

open_questions: Which refund cases still need a human, and why?
Who owns the build-versus-buy decision for AI?
How will the CFO judge ROI after one quarter?
What data can an agent access today?
Which migration milestones are already committed?

action_plan.action: Map the champion and economic buyer; agree on the pilot scope and success criteria.
Run the refund agent pilot; open the finance routines conversation with the CFO.
Present pilot results to the CFO with a 12-month expansion plan.

outreach.opening_signal: (Fictional) the CEO named margin per booking as the 2027 focus.
outreach.message_fr:
Bonjour,

J'ai lu que la marge par réservation était votre priorité pour 2027. Pendant les grèves, vos équipes traitent les remboursements à la main, dans plusieurs outils.

Grok Bot, ce sont des agents qui travaillent dans vos outils comme des collègues : ils traitent les dossiers de remboursement et vous rendent un rapport chaque soir.

Seriez-vous ouvert à un échange de 20 minutes pour voir si un pilote sur un marché aurait du sens ?

Bonne journée,
outreach.message_en:
Hello,

I read that margin per booking is your priority for 2027. During strikes, your teams process refunds by hand, across several tools.

Grok Bot is a team of agents that work in your tools like colleagues: they process refund files and send you a report every evening.

Would you be open to a 20-minute call to see whether a pilot on one market makes sense?

Best regards,
